card.name: Inside the word contraindicated
card.fires_on: The middle piece "ain" in the word "contraindicated", split as contr-ain-dicated, in contraindication sections of drug labels. Rarely on "percent" after a number in comparisons.

modes.label: contr-ain-dicated
modes.description: The "ain" piece in "contraindicated" right after "are" or "is" and before "in patients with".
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Pregabalin is contr<<ain>>dicated in patients with known hypersensitivity

modes.label: Percent in risk comparisons
modes.description: Rare firing on the word "percent" after a number in a risk comparison.
modes.example: the risk was 45<< percent>> less than participants whose intake was lowest.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of the word "contraindicated" when a label says a drug should not be used in certain patients.
